sections.title: CENTRAL PLAINS INTO UPPER MS RIVER VALLEY/WRN GREAT LAKES
sections.text: BROAD MID/UPPER LEVEL TROUGH WILL REMAIN IN PLACE ACROSS THE NRN PLAINS INTO THE INTERMOUNTAIN WEST...WITH SEVERAL LOW AMPLITUDE WAVES EJECTING ENEWD OUT OF THE CENTRAL ROCKIES AND INTO THE GREAT LAKES REGION. UNSEASONABLY COOL/STABLE AIRMASS WILL REMAIN ESTABLISHED OVER THE NRN PLAINS/ROCKIES IN WAKE OF SURFACE COLD FRONT EXPECTED TO EXTEND FROM THE NRN GREAT LAKES SEWD INTO KS BY LATE TODAY. TAIL END OF THIS FRONT IS EXPECTED TO STALL OVER THE SRN/CENTRAL HIGH PLAINS AND ALLOW ESELY SURFACE WINDS TO BECOME ESTABLISHED LATER THIS AFTERNOON INTO THE CENTRAL HIGH PLAINS. WIDESPREAD MOIST CONVECTION IS EXPECTED TO PERSIST OVER PORTIONS OF THE LOWER MO/MID MS RIVER VALLEY INTO THE UPPER MS RIVER VALLEY/WRN GREAT LAKES FOR MUCH OF THE DAY AND LIMIT INSTABILITY ACROSS THIS REGION. ALTHOUGH INSTABILITY WILL LIKELY REMAIN MEAGER...SHEAR IS EXPECTED TO REMAIN FAIRLY STRONG /ESPECIALLY ACROSS NRN PORTIONS OF THE AREA/ AHEAD OF ADVANCING COLD FRONT AND NEAR A LOW CENTER TRACKING NEWD ACROSS NRN MN.
